boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase activities at JBU and in Siloam Springs, using sources that explicitly state free access or a free event cost.

cards.title: Candlelight Service
cards.subtitle: Cathedral of the Ozarks
cards.notes: Plan a December evening at JBU’s annual Candlelight Service. Doors open at 6:30 p.m.; arrive early because seating is first come, first served.
cards.short_summary: A documented JBU holiday service open without tickets.
cards.evidence_claim: JBU states that Candlelight is free and no tickets are needed.
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the Cathedral of the Ozarks; confirm the year’s dates before going.

cards.entity_name: Siloam Springs Public Library Resident Borrowing
cards.title: Borrow a Library Stack
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Public Library
cards.notes: If you live inside Siloam Springs city limits, bring the required identification, get a free card, and check out books, magazines, CDs, or other materials.
cards.short_summary: A resident library card unlocks physical borrowing at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists resident adult and child library cards as free and gives checkout limits for cardholders.
cards.source_title: Library Cards | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Free-card eligibility is limited to residents inside city limits; bring two forms of ID.

cards.entity_name: Siloam Springs Public Library Document Scanning
cards.title: Scan a Document to Email
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Public Library
cards.notes: Bring a paper document and use the library’s scan-to-email option for a practical, low-key stop between classes or errands.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost library service for turning paper into an emailed file.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s fee page says documents scanned to an email are free.
cards.source_title: Library Cards | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Ask library staff about available equipment and current procedures.

cards.title: Morning Book Club
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Public Library, Meeting Room A
cards.notes: Watch the library calendar for a Morning Book Club session, then bring the selected title or borrow it ahead of the discussion.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed adult discussion program with a stated free cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Morning Book Club event listing identifies the library meeting room and lists the cost as free.
cards.source_title: Morning Book Club (Adult Program) | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: The cited listing is for a scheduled session; check the calendar for future dates and reading selections.

cards.title: See a Library Ballet Program
cards.subtitle: Memorial Park Chautauqua Amphitheater
cards.notes: Check library programming for family performances at the amphitheater; this listed NWA Ballet Theatre session gave visitors a free arts outing.
cards.short_summary: A city calendar example of a free performance in Memorial Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s NWA Ballet Theatre Family Program listing at the Chautauqua Amphitheater lists the cost as free.
cards.source_title: NWA Ballet Theatre (Family Program) | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: The cited performance was date-specific; check the library calendar for future free family programs.

cards.entity_name: Monday Movie: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
cards.title: Catch a Monday Movie
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Public Library, Meeting Room B
cards.notes: Use the library calendar to find a Monday Movie and settle in for an all-ages screening; the cited program included free popcorn.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed G-rated library movie program with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Monday Movie listing identifies a G-rated screening, says free popcorn is provided, and lists the cost as free.
cards.source_title: Monday Movie: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: The cited screening was date-specific; confirm future movie titles and times on the library calendar.

cards.title: Join Children’s Book Club
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Public Library, Storytime Room
cards.notes: For students volunteering with younger siblings or visiting family, check the library calendar for book-club sessions; the cited event supplied the book.
cards.short_summary: A free, book-provided library activity for ages 8–12.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Children’s Book Club listing says books will be provided and lists the event cost as free.
cards.source_title: Children's Book Club (Ages 8-12) | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Designed for ages 8–12 and scheduled by date; consult the library calendar for future sessions.

cards.title: Cool Off at the Water Feature
cards.subtitle: Memorial Park
cards.notes: On a summer day, use the button on the gray bollard to start the water for 20 minutes, then enjoy the surrounding lawn and downtown setting.
cards.short_summary: A city-operated interactive water feature in Memorial Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Memorial Park’s water feature operates daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. during the summer and explains how visitors activate it.
cards.source_title: Memorial Park Chautauqua Amphitheater | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Summer only; it may reduce spray or shut off in high winds. No dogs or glass in the feature.

cards.title: Watch the River at Kayak Park
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs Kayak Park
cards.notes: Visit during a free-parking day to watch the engineered rapids, use the picnic area, or spend time at the accessible riverbank without bringing equipment.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront park with rapids, picnic space, and a seasonal free-use policy.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Kayak Park is free to all users most of the year and lists picnic and accessible-riverbank amenities.
cards.source_title: Kayak Park | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Free most of the year; summer weekend parking between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day costs $10 per car.

cards.title: Walk Dogwood Springs Trail
cards.subtitle: Siloam Springs walking trail network
cards.notes: Choose a section that fits your time, walk or roll with a friend, and use the city’s trail map and safety guidance before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A city trail intended for walking, rolling, recreation, and connecting local green spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Dogwood Springs Trail links parks, green spaces, schools, downtown, and neighborhoods and may be enjoyed by everyone.
cards.source_title: Walking Trail | City of Siloam Springs
cards.access_notes: Use the city’s trail map and walking-safety resources; choose daylight and follow posted rules.
